title: Arena variants — open plaza + cross arena + pit (3 of 4 from GDP-2026-05-26-001 still missing after S140)
intent: S140 shipped the corridor arena + map-registry infrastructure + random-map-per-pageload default. The other 3 arena variants from `GDP-2026-05-26-001` — open plaza, cross arena, pit — are still missing. Re-file as a focused follow-up: now that the map registry pattern is proven (S140 FEAT-KABOOM-MAP-REGISTRY-001) and the generator config-switch path is open, adding 3 more variants is mostly data + a balance pass per variant. Quadruples session topology variety beyond the current default/wide/corridor trio.
rationale: Source: `GDP-2026-05-26-001` (4-variant proposal, partially shipped). S140 took the minimum-viable slice (1 variant + registry); the remaining 3 deliver the full content batch. After multi-bot solo (S141) the game shows three distinct bots in every round; pairing that with 5-6 distinct arenas (default + wide + corridor + plaza + cross + pit) gives sessions a real 'never the same twice' feel.
acceptanceHints: Reference: GDP-2026-05-26-001 acceptance hints — variant specifications (dimensions, soft-block density, spawn-cell layout) are already documented there. This story is implementation of the 3 unfinished variants on top of S140's map-registry infrastructure.

examples/kaboom-crew/generators/kaboom-arena-small.gen.mjs: extend the variant enum to include 'plaza' | 'cross' | 'pit' alongside the existing 'corridor' addition. Each variant is a config switch in the generator.
Variant specifications (refresher from GDP-2026-05-26-001):
plaza — 13×11, ~20% soft-block density (much sparser), 2 corner spawns. Wider lanes, fewer obstacles. Rewards long-range Fire-Up + Pierce bomb chains.

cross — 17×17 with hard-block walls forming a + shape that creates 4 quadrants connected through a 3×3 centre plaza. ~35% soft-block density in quadrants + 0% in centre. 4 spawns at the quadrant corners. Encourages 2v2 + 3v1 multi-bot scenarios.

pit — 11×11 with a hard-block ring around the perimeter (everything outside the inner 9×9 is hard wall). ~45% soft-block density in interior. 2 corner spawns inside the ring. Smaller play space; faster engagements.
examples/kaboom-crew/scenes/: NEW scene files plaza.scene.json, cross.scene.json, pit.scene.json. Generated via the extended generator, checked in as data alongside corridor.scene.json from S140.

MAP REGISTRY: extend the registry from S140 FEAT-KABOOM-MAP-REGISTRY-001. Each new map registers with name + display label + scene path. The random-default picker from S140 FEAT-KABOOM-RANDOM-MAP-DEFAULT-001 picks uniformly across all 6 maps (default, wide, corridor, plaza, cross, pit). URL override `?map=plaza|cross|pit` works alongside existing maps.

MULTI-BOT INTERACTION (from S141): cross arena's 4 spawn cells natively support 4 bombers — 1 player + 3 bots map cleanly. Plaza + pit have 2 spawn cells; the multi-bot solo (S141) currently spawns 3 bots — verify the multi-bot bootstrap handles 2-spawn arenas gracefully (recommendation: cap bot count at spawn-cell count - 1; document if not already enforced).
MULTIPLAYER (server side, post-GDP-022-011 server-authoritative gameplay): map config per world. Existing server scene-load path takes the variant. Snapshot tells clients which arena was loaded.
BALANCE CHECKS (each variant must pass on its own):

bot-vs-bot.test.ts variants: run the regression test on each of plaza / cross / pit. Each variant resolves within the existing 60s budget. If any doesn't, tune that variant's soft-block density or spawn spacing.
Plaza minimum: 6 soft blocks reachable per bomber from spawn within 5 cells.
Cross: 4-way connectivity confirmed (no quadrant isolated from the centre).
Pit: spawn cells inside the ring, both spawns visible to bot navigation from each other within 3 bomb-clears.
HUD: existing arena-name indicator from S140 should pick up the new variants. Update DOC-KABOOM-MAP-VARIETY-001 doc lines if the display labels differ.
UNIT TESTS:
Generator emits valid scenes for plaza + cross + pit (schema-validates via engine:check).
Each variant's soft-block + hard-block counts match the spec.
Spawn cells are non-blocking + non-overlapping per variant.
Random-map picker (S140) returns plaza/cross/pit with ≥ 1/6 frequency each across 600 iterations.
OUT OF SCOPE (as in original GDP-2026-05-26-001):
Dynamic arena (changes mid-round).
Player-editable arenas / level editor.
Procedural arena generation beyond the 6 fixed variants.
Per-variant power-up balance tweaks.
